Existing trees appear only as narrow edge strips. No flags or poles anywhere in the image, including the roof. People: absent or only tiny anonymous distant figures with no recognisable faces. No text, signs, labels, readable brands, logos, watermark, UI, border or frame.
Lighting and moment: Clear bright late-morning light with a clean soft-blue sky and a few thin clouds, subtle warm sunlight on the white stone, precise shadows defining the recessed facade and bronze window grid. Natural muted city colours, professional architectural travel photograph.
